security_implications: The chunk exposes sha_en, hmac_en, and digest_size_supplied directly from CSR fields without any qualification; an attacker who can modify these CSR values controls core security operation. The unused_cfg_qe signal XORs the qe bits of several critical configuration registers (sha_en, hmac_en, endian_swap, digest_swap, key_swap, digest_size, key_length) but is not read in this region; if never consumed, the XOR may be optimized away, removing any inherent monitoring of CSR toggling that could detect stuck-at faults or silent tampering. The digest_size_supplied cast from a raw register field may produce X for illegal enumerations, risking propagation of unknown state into digest length processing.
